steps.what: Verify source records and define the scope of water health documentation
Compile the selected measurements and references into documentation tables
Interpret water health findings and accept the documentation revision

tasks.design: Configure tables in {DOCS} from a specialist-verified input sheet. The specialist retains interpretation, source qualification and acceptance of each water health revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence arrived in mixed reports and repeated table copying followed verification.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed table template can consume explicitly selected measurements and citations.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling gaps and incompatible methods can make apparently comparable readings misleading.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what the evidence establishes about this body of water.
tasks.altitude: Less table assembly; interpretation and release rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How sampling limitations affect management conclusions

evidence.claim: Deterministic assembly of selected water measurements into fixed documentation tables is feasible; the local savings scenario is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is compilation and maintenance of documentation, excluding sampling and new pollution investigations. Source production is counted in those tasks once, not saved here.

In s1 the specialist captures water body ID, station, sample date, parameter, value, unit, method, qualification, source version and selected citation into the input sheet; its 40 hours include manual transcription and verification. Missing or incompatible fields stay in manual documentation; no automatic health classification is assumed.
Test native document table configuration before code. Existing storage runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: How much documentation time is repeated table assembly
Whether sources have consistent units and identifiers
research_questions: Can a previous reporting cycle be reproduced without losing qualifications or source lineage?

incremental.description: Template upkeep and failed table runs

approvals.approved_version: Exact water body, reporting period, tables, qualifications and interpretation in the accepted revision; changes void acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario B=100, R=70, gross=30, focal upkeep=7, central net=23. Range 0-8 allows short, infrequent documents or mostly narrative evidence to leave little repeatable table work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify and characterize plausible sources of water pollution against field and laboratory evidence

tasks.design: Keep pollution attribution with the specialist. Existing evidence in {DOCS} supports the assessment, but no separate copying or drafting share is established by this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Pollutant observations do not by themselves establish a source or causal path.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records can inform assessment without transferring the causal judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Multiple sources, transport delays and incomplete samples can fit the same observations.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a plausible source from an evidenced attribution and decide what to investigate next.
tasks.altitude: Assessment time and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How uncertainty affects the evidence needed for attribution

evidence.claim: Pollution source attribution requires contextual interpretation of observations and sampling limitations; no local automated attribution capability is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is causal assessment, excluding sample collection, GIS compilation and documentation maintenance, whose effort belongs to their own tasks.

Field staff and laboratories produce observations and results before assessment; the specialist verifies provenance, locations, times, methods and uncertainty within s1. No structured confirmed-source flag is supplied free of work.
Native evidence retrieval is considered before new code. No implementation or recurring service is proposed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Available source inventories and sampling coverage
Whether attribution standards require additional evidence
research_questions: Which past source assessments remained ambiguous after reviewing all available monitoring evidence?

incremental.description: No new service or transferred work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. No independent administrative or analytical substep has a supported time reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Conduct or oversee water quality monitoring and sampling against the applicable monitoring plan

tasks.design: Retain physical sampling, condition checks and oversight with qualified people. The monitoring plan in {DOCS} guides the work; existing instruments do not create a new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Representativeness and sample integrity depend on physical conditions and execution.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability removes those actions under the stated task boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected site conditions and compromised samples require intervention.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when the prescribed sampling activity will not produce defensible evidence.
tasks.altitude: Field responsibilities and oversight remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review deviations from the monitoring plan
reach.learn: When to repeat sampling or revise coverage

evidence.claim: Physical water sampling and oversight retain human execution and judgement; this design does not establish a separate reducible paperwork baseline.

assumptions: Boundary is conduct or oversight of monitoring and sampling, excluding subsequent laboratory analysis and reporting compilation. Other staff execution remains unchanged outside this focal oversight scenario.

The responsible scientific lead supplies the monitoring plan before work. The specialist checks station, timing, method, equipment condition and deviations during s1 and records observations during execution; no ready-to-sample or compliant flag is assumed.
Test existing monitoring tools before custom code if a later paperwork baseline is established. No new service is proposed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether the specialist samples personally or oversees field staff
Current instrument capture and chain-of-custody process
research_questions: Does time observation reveal a separate repeated recording step beyond necessary field checks?

already_counted.description: Sampling or oversight, condition checks and observation capture

incremental.description: No new process or maintenance obligation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and net=0 with zero upkeep. Instrument runtime is not human time and no additional recording baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify water resource data and define geographic compilation inputs
Compile selected geographic layers using the geographic information system
Review spatial alignment and accept the compiled water resource dataset

tasks.design: Configure a repeatable layer compilation in {OTHER}, the geographic information system. A specialist supplies the transformation manifest and checks spatial meaning before accepting the dataset.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated layer imports and joins followed manual source selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved geographic processing operations can rerun explicit transformations.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinate systems, resolution and observation dates can make a technically valid join unsuitable.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the resulting spatial representation is appropriate for the water resource question.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated layer assembly; source choice and acceptance remain human.

reach.task: Use geographic evidence in a monitoring plan
reach.learn: How resolution and location uncertainty constrain interpretation

evidence.claim: Geographic information systems can rerun explicit layer import, transformation and join operations; this water dataset design and savings estimate remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is compilation from existing datasets, not field positioning, sample collection or pollution attribution. Those producers retain their original effort.

In s1 the specialist captures dataset version, feature ID, geometry, coordinate reference system, units, observation date, join key, permitted transformation and output extent. The 40 hours include obtaining missing metadata and manual correction. Uncertain joins or coordinate systems stop for manual compilation rather than inferred mappings.
OTHER means the geographic information system in all three steps. Test its native saved processing configuration before code. Existing automated imports earn no new labour saving.
unknowns: Whether dataset licenses and metadata permit reproducible compilation
research_questions: Can a saved compilation reproduce known spatial relationships and preserve source lineage on the next dataset version?

already_counted.description: Manifest capture and geographic source validation

incremental.description: Maintain processing parameters and investigate failed runs

approvals.approved_version: Exact source versions, transformation manifest, layer geometries, attributes and validation log of the accepted dataset; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=65, gross=35, focal upkeep=9, central net=26. Range 0-10 allows existing saved processes or substantial manual coordinate and join repair to remove most proposed savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeatable document tables and geographic layer assembly shrink; sampling, attribution and scientific acceptance remain with the specialist.
reach: Work with a natural sciences manager on evidence sufficiency and monitoring design
role.ambitious_version: A specialist who can reproduce a documented spatial evidence base while preserving the distinction between measurements and causal conclusions.
